title: Collections Standard: Repeat-Lateness Pull-Ahead on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Catch-Up Payment
content:
**Collections standard, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** A contract with a record of late charges pulls part of the next installment into its catch-up payment.

**Rule.** When the contract shows at least 2 late charges in the last 12 calendar months and is not enrolled in autopay, 50 percentage points are added to the pull-ahead share; when it shows at least one late charge in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met, 25 points are added; in every other case nothing is added to it.

The points are added to the pull-ahead share that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to one monthly payment.

| Late charges, last 12 calendar months | Autopay | Points added to the pull-ahead share |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | not enrolled | 50 |
| 2 or more | enrolled | 25 |
| exactly 1 | either | 25 |
| none | either | 0 |

**Records and counting.** Late charges are the late charge entries on the contract's ledger, by their dates; autopay enrolment is read from the contract record. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

*Hypothetical:* a contract with 3 late charges in the window and no autopay adds 50 points; the same contract enrolled in autopay adds 25.
